data.long_meaning: Andraste is derived from the Greek name Andras, which means 'man' or 'manly'. The prefix 'an' in Andraste means 'in' or 'of'. Thus, Andraste means 'strength in God' or 'man of God'. In Christian tradition, Andraste is associated with the martyr Saint Andras, who is believed to have been a soldier in the Roman army and was executed for refusing to renounce his faith.

in_latin.long_meaning: Andraste, ex Graeco τπανρίτε, id est fortis, magnificus, virtuosus, nobilis, clarus, strenuus. Nomen Christianum, quod in ecclesia Christiana usitatum est ab antiquo.
